reviews.text: i literally have no complaints for this eyeliner. it doesn’t smudge and it’s the perfect hardness to line my inner lower lid. even as time goes by, it just kind of falls apart instead of giving panda eyes. i recommend it if you don’t like too soft or creamy liners and want more control but want to avoid panda eyes
reviews.zh: 我對呢支眼線筆完全冇投訴。佢唔暈，硬度剛剛好可以畫到內眼線下眼皮。時間耐咗，佢只會輕微甩色而唔會變熊貓眼。如果你唔鍾意太軟或者太 creamy 嘅眼線筆，想有多啲控制但又怕變熊貓眼，推薦呢支。

reviews.text: It’s the perfect shade for a subtle eyeliner - like it looks natural, as though it’s a natural shadow from the fold of the skin around your eyes. It adds dimension but is almost difficult to tell that it’s eyeliner. The shade looks darker in this pic but it’s more subtle in person and in the eyeline.
reviews.zh: 呢個色號係淡妝眼線嘅完美選擇——望落好自然，好似眼周皮膚摺位嘅自然陰影。佢增加立體感，但幾乎睇唔出係眼線。相入面睇落深色啲，但實際同畫喺眼上面都比較淡。

reviews.text: Been waiting for This color to be back in stock for a while! I was so happy to see that it was available! This formulation is quite good. However, I do find that I still need to wear an eye primer before I use it otherwise, the eyeliner will not stay.
reviews.zh: 等咗好耐呢隻色先返貨！見到佢有貨真係好開心！呢個配方幾好。不過，我發現用之前仲係需要搽眼瞼底霜，否則眼線會 hold 唔住。

reviews.text: The eye liner is a great texture and doesn’t really smudge. I’ve always used liquid eye liner. The only issue was when you use it the first time, the pencil is very blunt so you may want to draw on your hand or paper first to get the pencil going.
reviews.zh: 呢支眼線筆質地好好，基本上唔暈。我一向都用液體眼線筆。唯一問題係第一次用嘅時候筆芯好鈍，所以可能想喺手背或者紙上畫幾下先出到墨。

reviews.text: These are my now go-to eye liners, i love the difference in colours for different uses. Glides on well, smudges well and is forgiving if you make a mistake. Will last majority of the day unless i’m sweating more than expected and need to splash my face with water after. Will continue to purchase!
reviews.zh: 呢啲而家係我嘅主力眼線筆，我鍾意唔同色嘅唔同用途。滑順好畫，好容易暈開，就算畫錯都仲有救。除非出汗多過預期要用水洗面，否則大部分時間都可以 keep 到成日。會繼續回購！

reviews.text: I like the color a lot. Using it as an accent color blended with a dark brown eyeliner looks very nice. It certainly is waterproof as it took multiple times to wash off the back of my hand, but it definitely smudges when it's around your eyes, even with an eyelid primer and setting spray. Needs touch ups throughout the day but overall I like it. Also glides on very smoothly.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢隻色。配深啡色眼線筆做 highlight 色效果好好。佢真係防水，手背要洗好多次先洗得甩，但上眼真係會暈，就算用咗眼瞼底霜同定妝噴霧都係。一日入面要補妝，但整體我鍾意。而且滑順好畫。

reviews.text: Unfortunately, I found that the 06 Vanilla Beige shade to be a little too dark for making aegyosal. I have to use a VERY light hand when I do use it. If you have very fair skin, I'd avoid this. The other dark shades for eyeliner use are great as well (I own black and dark brown) but they are not waterproof. They smudge if you have oily lids or if you have watery eyes so don't expect any miracles with this eyeliner.
reviews.zh: 可惜，我覺得 06 Vanilla Beige 呢隻色用嚟畫臥蠶有少少深。用嘅時候我要好輕力。如果你皮膚好白，我會建議避免。其他深色用嚟畫眼線都幾好（我有黑色同深啡色），但唔防水。如果你油眼瞼或者眼水多，佢哋會暈，所以唔好對呢支眼線筆抱太大期望。

reviews.text: I don't know if I'd call this shade Ash Brown personally because it's still a really warm but just a bit more muted brown. However, it's still a gorgeous shade and looks amazing with more subtle eye makeup. The original sharp so simple liner was my HG for many years and I think the renewal has better longevity and pigment so the performance is great!
reviews.zh: 我個人就唔會叫呢隻色做 Ash Brown，因為佢其實仲係好暖色嘅啡色，只係靜咗少少。不過佢仲係一隻好靚嘅色，配淡妝眼妝好好睇。原裝 sharp so simple 眼線筆做咗我好多年嘅最愛，我覺得新版持久度同顯色度都提升咗，所以表現好好！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
